description: OBČINA KANAL OB SOČI: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA KANAL OB SOČI. Coverage: OBČINA KANAL OB SOČI. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Javna parkirišča v občini KANAL OB SOČI; Javna parkirna mesta v občini KANAL OB SOČI; Ulična parkirna mesta v občini KANAL OB SOČI; Posebna parkirna mesta v občini KANAL OB SOČI. Formats seen: CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
